name: AIS
note: On the back of Buriram United's 2026-27 domestic home shirt (above the player number); added to the club's partner strip in August 2026. Left unrated for a maintainer. Proposed Concern: Singapore's state holds about 12.5% of AIS through the chain Singapore government -> Temasek (sole equity shareholder) -> Singtel (Temasek holds 50.57%) -> 24.8% of AIS (not control: AIS's largest holder is Gulf Development PCL at 40.44%), and Singapore carries out executions for drug-related offences (17 executions in 2025, 15 drug-related; UN experts condemned them in August 2026). AIS's shareholder list also shows Thai state funds Vayupak Fund 1 (3.32%) and the Social Security Office (1.44%) - Thailand has no qualifying record in this data. Quick company check (2026-09-30): no human-rights finding against AIS itself identified.
